concat_all_gather: gather tensors from all GPUs with padding support for uneven batch sizes across distributed processes
batch_shuffle: shuffle a tensor across all GPUs in a distributed training setup using random permutation and broadcast
batch_unshuffle: restore the original tensor order after a cross-GPU batch shuffle using the saved unshuffle indices
wrap_shuffle: create a wrapper class that applies batch shuffle and unshuffle around a module method during training
mask_rcnn_bnhead_shuffle_config: configure a Mask R-CNN model with cross-GPU batch shuffling applied to box and mask ROI heads
